channelTrustFloor.heading: Who can message {assistant}
channelTrustFloor.loadFailed: Couldn’t load this setting. Try reopening this page.
channelTrustFloor.trustedContactsNotice: People you haven’t verified yet (even teammates in the same channel) can’t get through: {assistant} lets them know they need to be verified and notifies you. You can verify people ahead of time in Contacts.

noOne.label: No one
noOne.description: No one can message {assistant} on this channel: every message is blocked, including yours.
noOne.confirmMessage:
Setting this channel to “No one” hard-denies every inbound message, including messages from you.

You can reverse this at any time.

guardianOnly.label: Only you
guardianOnly.description: Only you can message {assistant}. Everyone else is turned away.

trustedContacts.label: Verified contacts
trustedContacts.description: You and the people you’ve verified can message {assistant}. Anyone else is asked to verify first, and you’re notified.

anyContact.label: Any contact
anyContact.description: You and any known contact can message {assistant}, including contacts you haven’t verified yet. Strangers are asked to verify first.
anyContact.confirmMessage:
“Any contact” admits every matched contact in this channel (including pending, unverified ones), not just your verified contacts.

Best for channels consisting of only people you already trust.

strangers.label: Strangers
strangers.description: Anyone can message {assistant}, including complete strangers.
strangers.confirmMessage:
Are you sure you want to allow strangers to contact your assistant through this channel?

Doing so could cost you money and open you up to security and privacy vulnerabilities.

Enable with extreme caution.
